definition: to officially join a course, program or school
vi: ghi danh, đăng ký nhập học (khóa học)
example: I plan to enroll in an evening payroll course at a local college this fall.

definition: money paid for being taught at a school, college or university
example: International students pay much higher tuition fees than domestic students.

definition: money given to a student to help pay for education, often for good results
example: My nephew received a scholarship that covers half of his first-year tuition.

definition: a course or condition you must complete before you can do something else
vi: điều kiện tiên quyết, môn học bắt buộc trước
example: Introductory Accounting is a prerequisite for the Intermediate Accounting course.

definition: qualifications or documents that prove your education or skills
vi: bằng cấp, chứng chỉ (chứng minh trình độ)
example: Many immigrants must have their foreign credentials assessed before working in their field.

definition: to improve your abilities, especially through training
example: Taking an online Excel course is an easy way to upgrade your skills in the evenings.
collocations: a chance to upgrade your skills

definition: classes for adults who have finished their basic schooling
vi: giáo dục thường xuyên, chương trình học cho người lớn
example: The college's continuing education department offers part-time courses in project management.

definition: a course you take over the internet
example: An online course lets me study after my kids go to bed.

definition: a piece of work given to a student
example: The final assignment is due on December 5 and is worth 30 percent of the grade.

definition: extra time given to finish work after the original due date
example: I asked my instructor for a deadline extension because I was sick for a week.

definition: a meeting between a parent and a teacher to discuss a child's progress
vi: buổi họp phụ huynh với giáo viên
example: At the parent-teacher conference, the teacher said my son needs more help with reading.

definition: activities such as sports or clubs done outside regular classes
example: Extracurricular activities like soccer and band help children build confidence.

definition: all the subjects and content taught in a school or course
example: Many parents want financial literacy to be part of the high school curriculum.

definition: a short course of study that gives a certificate rather than a degree
vi: chương trình đào tạo cấp chứng chỉ
example: She completed an eight-month certificate program in supply chain management.

definition: a period of training where you learn a trade while working
example: He started an electrical apprenticeship after finishing high school.

definition: an official record of a student's courses and grades
example: The college asked me to submit an official transcript from my university in Vietnam.

definition: a staff member who helps students plan their courses
example: My academic advisor suggested taking two courses per term while working full-time.

definition: to leave school or a course before finishing it
example: He had to drop out of the program when his work hours changed.

definition: to fail to keep up with work or with others
vi: bị tụt lại phía sau, chậm tiến độ
example: If you miss more than two classes, it's easy to fall behind.

definition: to do things you did not have time to do earlier
vi: bắt kịp, làm bù (việc bị bỏ lỡ)
example: I spent Sunday catching up on the readings I missed last week.

definition: the time and effort needed to learn a new skill or system
vi: quá trình làm quen, độ khó khi học cái mới
example: The new accounting software has a steep learning curve, but it saves time later.

definition: lessons where students and teacher are physically in the same room
example: Some students prefer in-person classes because they can ask questions easily.

definition: education after high school, such as college or university
vi: sau trung học (cao đẳng, đại học)
example: Many BC high school graduates go on to post-secondary education.

definition: money borrowed to pay for education, paid back later
example: It took her eight years to pay off her student loan.

definition: a visit away from school for students to learn something
vi: chuyến tham quan học tập, dã ngoại
example: The Grade 4 class went on a field trip to the aquarium in Stanley Park.

definition: a private teacher who teaches one student or a small group
example: We hired a math tutor to help our daughter prepare for her final exams.

definition: abilities that are useful in real situations
example: Employers often value practical skills more than high grades.

definition: a small group of students who meet to study together
example: Joining a study group helped me stay motivated during my CPA courses.

definition: to complete a course of study at a school or university
example: She graduated from Simon Fraser University with a degree in business.

definition: being present at classes, work or an event
vi: sự có mặt, sự chuyên cần
example: Attendance is mandatory for the first two classes of the program.
